flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: About Pioneering Intelligence Pioneering Intelligence builds on Flagship Pioneering’s legacy of founding cutting-edge science and computational ventures, harnessing recent advances in AI, machine learning, and data to accelerate fundamental research and create a portfolio of AI-first companies. As part of Flagship’s integrated model of science, entrepreneurship, and capital, it transforms breakthrough ideas into world-changing companies, elevating the AI advances happening across the ecosystem in human health, sustainability, and beyond. The Role Pioneering Intelligence is seeking a Lead for Flagship's ambitious efforts to build polyintelligent AI systems that unify human scientific expertise, machine intelligence, and nature’s biological signals into multi-modal, multi-scale reasoning engines for biology. As Lead, you will have the unique opportunity to shape our biological reasoning efforts on both the technical and application levels. You will be a hands-on lead for a team of talented machine learning scientists innovating on model architectures that will create best-in-class biological reasoning engines. You will be responsible for sourcing high-value use cases across Flagship and its portfolio companies and translating these into requirements to develop the model towards optimal performance on the unconventional life sciences problems that Flagship tackles. You will work with teams in Pioneering Intelligence and Flagship-at-large to apply our reasoning engines to discover new biology and engineer new biological solutions through massively parallel in-silico reasoning. You will have the opportunity to originate and lead multiple projects in this space over time. Key Responsibilities Own the roadmap: lead the project from architecture and data exploration through model readiness, benchmarking, refinement, and agentic integration. Guide technical architecture through a biological lens: guide multi-modal, multi-scale model design and ensure the system can ingest and reason over modalities relevant to mechanism-of-action reasoning, target discovery, perturbation biology, pathway reasoning, protein function, and autonomous discovery workflows. Translate biology into model and evaluation requirements: ensure model development is driven by biological relevance that enables real scientific workflows, not just benchmark performance or technical elegance. Build the engine for a novel science platform: develop and integrate reasoning engines into Pioneering Intelligence's AI Scientist platform for autonomous science. Source and shape portfolio use cases: interface with Flagship teams and portfolio company end-users to identify use cases, source data assets, define success criteria, and create end-user feedback loops for reasoning engines that are scientifically meaningful, tractable, and answer high-value questions with real world application. Communicate the impact: disseminate strategic direction and scientific results to Flagship stakeholders and in public forums. Qualifications Industry-leading expertise in modern LLMs, multimodal modeling, representation learning, fine-tuning, post-training, benchmarking, and ML systems. Deep experience in computational biology, AI-for-biology, AI-enabled drug discovery, translational data science, biological foundation models, or scientific discovery platforms. Demonstrated ability to work with scientists or biotech teams to scope high-value use cases, identify data assets, define success criteria, and translate discovery needs into technical execution plans. Working knowledge of biological data modalities such as genomics, transcriptomics, perturbation data, protein sequence, protein structure, pathways, imaging, pathology, or time-series biological data. Strong judgment around mechanism-of-action reasoning, target discovery, perturbation biology, scientific credibility, model limitations, hallucination risk, interpretability, and validation. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:1c63a8a2-4c36-471.title: MassHealth Enrollment Specialist
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:1c63a8a2-4c36-471.description: MASSHEALTH ENROLLMENT SPECIALIST HELP PATIENTS KEEP THEIR HEALTH COVERAGE — AND HELP US BUILD A BETTER WAY TO DO IT. BridgeHealthAI is building technology for the healthcare safety net. We work with community health centers to make sure patients don’t lose access to healthcare because of paperwork, missed deadlines, or an impossible-to-navigate system. Our platform helps health centers identify patients who need support, reach them at scale, and automate the administrative work that takes their teams hours today. We’re a small, fast-moving team building at the intersection of healthcare, AI, and health equity. BridgeHealthAI was born out of Harvard and MIT and is backed by Pear VC, Flare Capital, and Glen Tullman, founder of Livongo. Now, we’re looking for someone who really knows MassHealth. THE ROLE Our technology can identify a patient who is at risk of losing coverage, reach them, and figure out where they’re getting stuck. You’ll help take them the rest of the way. That might mean getting on the phone with a patient to complete their renewal, figuring out what a confusing MassHealth notice actually means, tracking down a missing document, calling MassHealth with them, or making sure an application actually made it across the finish line. But this isn’t just an enrollment processing role. You’ll also be the MassHealth expert inside our company. You’ll work directly with our product and operations teams to show us where patients get stuck, what our technology gets wrong, and what we could automate or redesign to make the process dramatically easier. We’re still early, which means there’s a lot to figure out. If you like the idea of doing great work with patients and helping build a better system from the ground up, you’ll probably enjoy this role. WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO - Work one-on-one with MassHealth members by phone and video to complete applications and renewals, gather documents, respond to requests for information, and resolve eligibility issues. - Own patient cases from start to finish rather than simply handing them off after one interaction. - Support renewal campaigns across several of our community health center partners. - Help patients understand confusing MassHealth and Health Connector notices and work with customer service on their behalf when needed. - Keep health center teams in the loop and escalate the genuinely complicated cases. - Spot patterns in where patients are getting stuck and bring those insights directly to our product team. - Review patient outreach, scripts, and workflows and tell us when something doesn’t reflect how enrollment works in the real world. - Help us build the playbook for how BridgeHealthAI delivers enrollment support as we grow. YOU’LL PROBABLY BE GREAT AT THIS IF... - You have 3+ years of hands-on MassHealth enrollment, eligibility, or benefits experience. - You are currently or were previously a Massachusetts Certified Application Counselor and are eligible to be designated again through one of our partner health centers. - You know MassHealth well — eligibility rules, coverage types, renewals, requests for information, the Health Connector, and all the weird edge cases that come with them. - You’re great with patients. You can make a complicated or stressful process feel understandable and manageable. - You’re the person who catches the missing verification or incomplete application before it turns into a bigger problem. - You’re comfortable managing your own caseload and following things through without someone checking on you every day. - You’re tech-savvy and excited to try new tools. You’re curious about how AI can make enrollment work faster and easier, and you’re energized by experimenting with new technology rather than intimidated by it. - You like figuring things out. We’re an early-stage startup, so not every process will come with a perfect step-by-step playbook — sometimes we’ll build it together. BONUS POINTS We’d be especially excited if you: - Speak Spanish
